name: replayio
description: Direct Replay.io dev tools for Replay Chromium recording, rrweb streams watchable live or afterwards, worker/critic proof loops, upload hooks, and Replay MCP debugging.

interface.shortDescription: Direct Replay.io dev tools for recordings, rrweb streams, proof loops, and Replay MCP debugging
interface.longDescription: Every agent-browser session runs in Replay Chromium and is recorded as an rrweb stream to a .rrweb file, watchable in a browser while it runs and afterwards. Closing the browser uploads its Replay recordings. A worker/critic loop proves UI work against the uploaded recording, and Replay MCP debugs it.
defaultPrompt: Record an agent browser session against this local app, share its rrweb stream, and analyze the resulting recording
Inspect this uploaded Replay recording through Replay MCP and summarize the root cause evidence
Run a worker/critic Replay proof loop for this UI change
